methods.label: Equal angles and a 30° right triangle
methods.explanation: \(\angle B=\angle C=30^\circ\), and \(\angle DAC=120^\circ-90^\circ=30^\circ=\angle C\), so \(AD=DC=4\). In right triangle \(ABD\), \(\angle B=30^\circ\), so \(BD=2AD=8\) and \(BC=8+4=12\).
